messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell your doctor about any unusual or bothersome side effect"
set: ["tell your doctor about any unusual or bothersome side effect", "tell your doctor about any medicine started or stopped", "ask your doctor about any risk", "tell your doctor if you have any side effect that bothers you or that does not go away", "tell your doctor if any side effects bother you or do not go away", "tell your doctor about weight gain or increasing breathlessness", "inform doctor about any changes", "tell your doctor about all current medicines and any you start or stop using", "tell your doctor about all your medications and any you start or stop using during treatment", "tell doctor about vitamins", "tell doctor about minerals", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "tell any doctor or lab before tests", "call your doctor for medical advice about side effects", "tell your doctor about blurred vision or other vision changes", "tell your surgeon before any operation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
